## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the spatial extent or scope a creative work is about (Dublin Core spatial alignment).

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for where the work physically resides (use [`gmeow:locatedAt`](gmeow-locatedAt.md) / [`gmeow:storedIn`](gmeow-storedIn.md)) — coverage is aboutness, not location.

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:spatialCoverage`](gmeow-spatialCoverage.md) at a [`Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md); it projects to [dcterms:spatial](http://purl.org/dc/terms/spatial) and [schema:spatialCoverage.](https://schema.org/spatialCoverage.)

### Examples

- ex:work [`gmeow:spatialCoverage`](gmeow-spatialCoverage.md) ex:scotland.
